suggestions.title: 1. Chest Pain: what the heart research adds to your angina story
suggestions.reading: In the first batch, the section read [AI Detected, 78%](https://www.pangram.com/history/ce00d5dc-1e58-4c03-9b82-628409d40764), this paragraph in the AI High window.
suggestions.tested:
Your round-39 way (how far the evidence goes, each finding in plain words, the rats' timing): [AI Assisted, 50%](https://www.pangram.com/history/2c13fbe7-3693-4dcf-9726-cf6fea660532), every sentence AI-Assisted.

The rats cut (a fresh reader: given for three days before a heart attack, they tell a friend whose pain has started nothing), the clot first: "Chest pain can come from a clot starting to block an artery, so it's a good sign that DMSO slows clotting. It did in mice, and in human platelets (the blood cells that start clots) in a dish, though that's only animal and lab-dish research so far." With your angina story: [Human, Medium and Low](https://www.pangram.com/history/dbfa1b8b-a9f1-44a3-8bf5-d06f6c7e9a74) over those two sentences.

One sentence, no hedge tail or bracket: "Chest pain can come from a clot starting to block an artery, and DMSO slowed clotting in mice and in a dish of human platelets, the blood cells that start clots." With your story: [Human, Medium](https://www.pangram.com/history/b70b36a6-0b12-4e00-bf07-02e196b050ac) over that sentence, your story High.
suggestions.sense: A fresh reader said the rats given DMSO before a heart attack tell a friend nothing once the pain has started, and another asked how "the same way" points when your story was pain going away and the studies measured heart muscle and clotting.
suggestions.why: Your angina story reads Human High; every way I say what the research adds after it reads below High. The guide has more of these: the cyproheptadine evidence in the Serotonin Syndrome steps and the MDMA studies. How you'd say why the heart research backs your story, or whether it's needed at all, teaches me how to say those.
suggestions.advice_note: Edit it: what the heart research adds, in your words, or cut it if your story and the call list are enough. The clotting studies (mice, and human platelets in a dish) are the ones that bear on pain that has already started; the rat study gave DMSO for three days before the heart attack. Your version goes in whole, and I carry what it teaches to the other evidence paragraphs.
